research_index_rules: URLs and dates below are copied from explicit original access fields; a parent receipt date is marked by its original JSON pointer. Missing dates stay null. Index creation time is not a research-access time.

research_topics.topic: Host opening, context cancellation, and timeout ownership
research_topics.preserved_claim_and_use: Exact dependency sources bind resource creation/context ownership and timeout cancellation analysis; stacktrace recovery can copy exception instances and therefore constrains identity assertions.
research_topics.applicability: P2pKit 0.7.0-rc3 and kotlinx.coroutines 1.11.0, including common/JVM/Android/iOS source artifacts.
research_topics.limitations: Source provenance and coroutine semantics do not prove physical LAN delivery, cancellation scheduling on every device, or independently approve each fix without its issue dossier.

research_topics.topic: iOS backup exclusion and preference ownership
research_topics.preserved_claim_and_use: Apple documents backup-exclusion resource handling and preference domains. NSArgumentDomain precedes persistent application/global preferences; test launch arguments must not pin the locale being mutated.
research_topics.applicability: Foundation on the iOS implementation; preserved tests use disposable fixtures, not real player records.
research_topics.limitations: Backup policy is not observed iCloud durability. NSUserDefaults documentation or XCUIApplication termination alone does not prove every restart/process-death behavior.

research_topics.topic: Toast identities, CAS, and frame/owner observation
research_topics.preserved_claim_and_use: Coroutine updateAndGet returns the successful committed CAS value. Compose test clocks need actual frame advancement; owner/flow replacement was investigated using real source members rather than empty archives.
research_topics.applicability: kotlinx.coroutines 1.11.0; CMP ui-test/runtime metadata 1.10.3. That runtime module resolves an Android dependency to AndroidX runtime 1.10.5.
research_topics.limitations: Do not infer all platform variants from the Android mapping. An HTTP 200 empty source archive did not resolve the owner-flow hypothesis; the successor record supplies actual metadata/source members.

research_topics.topic: Mafia final-role layout and test geometry
research_topics.preserved_claim_and_use: Text overflow, wrapping, layout callers, and DpRect member/extension semantics were checked against published Compose sources before accepting the focused layout tests.
research_topics.applicability: CMP 1.10.3 source artifacts; caller record also identifies its Material3 version.
research_topics.limitations: Source and deterministic layout measurements do not establish physical VoiceOver/TalkBack or all large-text/device combinations.

research_topics.topic: Approved upload certificates and signed JAR/AAB integrity
research_topics.preserved_claim_and_use: JarFile payload verification requires reading entries and does not itself establish certificate validity. Explicit truststore leaf shortcuts, active algorithm/usage rules, and separate timestamp trust were reviewed before preserving approved-fingerprint enforcement.
research_topics.applicability: OpenJDK 21.0.11 tag jdk-21.0.11-ga, Oracle Java 21 APIs/specification, Android documented AAB jarsigner flow.
research_topics.limitations: Synthetic self-signed fixtures are local tooling tests, not real upload-key use, Store signing, upload, or approval. Trust anchors must not bypass the remaining security checks.

research_topics.topic: Portable file size and same-edit Google Play mutation
research_topics.preserved_claim_and_use: Python os.stat/stat supports portable size/type checks. Google Publisher edits define the transaction snapshot on which track read/validation/mutation/commit must agree.
research_topics.applicability: Documented Python 3.9 API (recorded interpreter 3.9.6); Android Publisher REST v3 edits and tracks.update.
research_topics.limitations: No live Play edit or publication occurred. API documentation and isolated transaction fixtures do not constitute Store evidence or a signed Linux release pipeline.

research_topics.topic: Kotlin native test registration and execution evidence
research_topics.preserved_claim_and_use: Native test task creation, executable wiring, registry and service-message executor semantics were checked against the actual KGP tag.
research_topics.applicability: Kotlin Gradle plugin v2.4.10; native task source is distinct from JUnit/Jupiter Desktop discovery protection.
research_topics.limitations: Task existence, compilation, and linkage are not test execution. The combined logs explicitly retain SKIPPED and NO-SOURCE outcomes.

research_topics.topic: UIKit containment and native layout direction
research_topics.preserved_claim_and_use: UIKit containment requires addChild, child-view insertion/geometry, and didMove; default appearance forwarding and child-directed system UI are documented. CMP hosting/layer source defines the actual direction boundary.
research_topics.applicability: CMP ui-uikitsimarm64 1.10.3 and public UIKit/SwiftUI APIs, app deployment target iOS 16.
research_topics.limitations: Containment documentation does not prove a specific SwiftUI semantic setter caused a failed run, nor that a replacement container passes end-to-end tests.

research_topics.topic: Objective-C category overrides and actual orientation policy
research_topics.preserved_claim_and_use: UIViewController category members are not covered by the documented UIView Kotlin-override exception. Complete CMP ancestor plus app controller source preserves the inherited default true autorotation policy; no unnecessary deprecated forwarding override is required.
research_topics.applicability: Repository Kotlin 2.4.10, CMP 1.10.3 tree c6b30f209d13913cb34d414db927f9a6bc41127d, applicable installed SDK categories. Published CMP binary compiler version 2.2.20 is a different domain.
research_topics.limitations: The earlier Kotlin 2.4.0 prose was wrong. Truncated upstream tree discovery proved only included requested paths, not absence of other files. SDK compilation failure was independently observed; this research alone is not native runtime proof.

research_topics.topic: Read-only native observation and weak-reference ownership
research_topics.preserved_claim_and_use: Kotlin ObjC weak-reference code uses the actual associated object, including Kotlin ObjC subclasses. viewIfLoaded avoids forced loading; safe-area/window and device-versus-UI orientation observations need attachment and actual window geometry.
research_topics.applicability: Kotlin v2.4.10 runtime implementation; public iOS APIs in the installed 26.5 simulator SDK with deployment target 16.
research_topics.limitations: No GC-stress proof follows from source inspection. Wrong container/orientation URLs returned 404/unresolved and were corrected separately, not silently treated as successful. Probe observations are not production mutations or own-fixture independent approval.

research_topics.topic: XCUI taps, public OS language prerequisites, and retained sessions
research_topics.preserved_claim_and_use: Hittability or a generated tap does not prove an app callback/route. Device language UI and multilingual per-app selection are documented; openSettingsURLString opens the app-specific pane, not an undocumented Language & Region deep link.
research_topics.applicability: Current XCUIAutomation and Apple Support; exact CMP 1.10.3 scrolling source. WWDC 2019 establishes intended multilingual per-app behavior but is not a guarantee of current iOS 26.5 Settings row semantics.
research_topics.limitations: Possible scrolling consumption is a source-level hypothesis, not proof the flag was true in the failed run. Public OS testing must use a fresh owned profile, preserve actual OS-managed preferences, and classify ambiguous/unreached selectors as evidence gaps. OS-driven relaunch is distinct from same-process retention.

research_topics.preserved_claim_and_use: A newer Ktor Mock publication exists, but its existence does not by itself explain a missing warning. The matching analyzer GradleDetector source supports the accepted-inventory investigation.
research_topics.applicability: Pinned Ktor Mock 3.0.3 versus recorded metadata latest 3.5.2; analyzer artifact lint-checks 32.1.1 corresponds to the independently pinned lint 9.1.1 toolchain.
research_topics.limitations: No dependency upgrade, advisory suppression, or verification-metadata regeneration is authorized by this research. Original production01/02/03 warning-gate failures remain evidence; current production04 outcome has its own review.
